svg.text: 2,000 events/s × 500 bytes · one consumer · us-east-1 · monthly fare at the smallest size that carries the load
Firehose is the "slow, cheap" option, and it costs 5.2× more than one-second Kinesis. Each 500-byte event is billed as 5 KB.
Source: realtime_cost.py, AWS Price List API offer files published September 11, 2026. Excludes cross-AZ transfer, the query layer, and headroom.
